chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
O company of traders, raise your heads, for the path has been made clear to you. You will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment as wicked sinners, except one whose speech is truthful.

key_terms.التُّجَّارِ: traders; those engaged in buying and selling
key_terms.الطَّرِيقُ: the clear path or proper course of conduct
key_terms.تُبْعَثُونَ: you will be resurrected and raised again

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about traders and truthfulness on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله warns traders that commercial life carries grave moral danger and that the correct path has already been clarified for them. On the Day of Resurrection, traders are threatened with being raised as sinners except those distinguished by truthfulness in their speech.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3728 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"O group of traders, raise your heads, for the path has been made clear for you. You will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment as transgressors, except those who speak the truth."
